messages:
Priya: Quick sync 3 follow up on provisional enrichment approach. Two open questions: dedupe window for backfill (how far back should the reclaim job search) and whether tombstone records should be mutable after replacement.
Omar: For dedupe window I propose 72h as the upper bound for automatic backfills. Anything older requires manual approval to avoid churn in billing. Storage impact noted but gives ops breathing room for delayed pipelines.
Talia: 72h feels heavy. Our reality: >95% of resolves are <1h. Suggest default 24h, with 72h as an emergency mode gated by policy and audits. Lower daily index size helps queries.
Ben: On tombstones: once a provisional event is replaced we should mark it immutable (set prov_replaced=true and final_tag_id). Allowing later mutation leads to billing churn and chase tickets. Maybe allow a short reconciliation window (1h) where corrections are allowed, then freeze.
ops-bot: note: last month a manual backfill caused duplicate charges b/c two backfills ran overlapping ranges. Recommend idempotent claim pattern.
Priya: Data model sketch (envelope): enrichment_provisional:boolean, prov_fp:string, prov_set_ts:int, prov_expiry_ts:int, prov_replaced_ts:int, prov_replaced_by:string. Example: ```json
{
  "enrichment_provisional": true,
  "prov_fp": "sha256:abcd1234ef",
  "prov_set_ts": 1700000000
}
```
Omar: Add prov_source enum (router|edge-proxy|dedicated-agent) so we can trace where fingerprints originate. Helpful for debugging region-specific spikes.
Talia: Metrics we should add quickly: prov.backfill_attempts, prov.backfill_claims, prov.duplicate_rejects, prov.replacement_latency_p95. Alerting: duplicate_rejects > 0.1% for 5m and replacement_p95 > 3m.
Ben: Rough retention/cost numbers: with our current ingest, a 24h prov index is ~150GB/day; 72h ~450GB. Ops: use TTL index on prov_fp and shard by region to bound costs.
Priya: Rollout plan: feature-flag + schema v2 envelope (backwards compatible). Canary path: staging -> canary EU cluster (5%) -> ramp to region. Monitor prov.replacement_latency_p95, prov.duplicate_rejects, prov.rate_by_region. Hard pause conditions: duplicate_rejects > 0.5% OR replacement_p95 > 3m.
Omar: Backfill job detail: job_run_id must be stamped on claims; claims include range_start/range_end and prov_fp list. Mark claimed entries with job_run_id to avoid double-claim when retries run.
Talia: Compliance note: for Dedicated/private tenants prov_fp must be tenant-scoped and not egressed to control plane. Add config flag `disable_provisional_for_private=true`.
Ben: Implementation notes: datastore schema will include TTL on prov_set_ts + prov_expiry_ts. Use compact prov_fp (sha256 truncated to 12 bytes hex) to reduce index size.
Priya: Documentation & runbook owners: Talia -> runbook (alerts + manual backfill playbook), Omar -> backfill job and query definitions, Ben -> datastore retention and schema migration. Targets: runbook 3d, backfill prototype 1w, TTL migration 1w.
ops-bot: reminder: related incident INC-2026-001 (2026-01-12) linked: https://redwood.internal/ops/INC-2026-001
Priya: Meeting scheduled Friday 10am to review canary metrics. If no objections Ill mark decision: adopt provisional fingerprint + tombstone + short reconciliation window (24h default, 72h emergency), immutable after 1h post-replace.
Omar: No objections.
Talia: No objections.
Ben: SGTM.
Priya: Thanks all 3 I'll file the schema PR and link the feature flag.
